plan: Since this is a single-round auction, and my value is $13, I want to bid slightly above what I expect the second-highest bid to be, while minimizing risk. Since this is a single-round auction and my value is $12, I want to win if possible, but avoid overpaying. The worst case is bidding too high and paying close to my value.
